item.title: Journalist Camilo Rodríguez, who reported on alleged drug trafficking and links to officials and had received death threats, is shot dead in his truck by two men on a motorcycle (CPJ, RSF)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Santo Domingo de Heredia, Costa Rica. Types: Attacks on journalists, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Two unidentified gunmen. Reported casualties: 1 killed. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1295
